message: What can a reader infer about the bird from your scene alone, excluding the questions and revision notes? Could Rohin’s reported C2 example—checking competing predictions against a calculation, then revising the next choice—help you compare your intended viewpoint with the words actually present? Would more thought settle your explicit-versus-implied choice, or would a small writing attempt provide better evidence? What thinking or doing step do you choose to complete next without waiting for approval? What observation in this passage would make you change that choice? What finding from your passage, uncertainty, decision, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
